title: ExecutionContractManifest.v1
description: Non-self-referential execution-segment contract preimage whose identity survives an agent replacement.
$comment: This exact object is the unambiguous execution_contract_id preimage. The gate computes execution_contract_id as sha256:<SHA-256(UTF-8 JCS RFC8785 bytes of this complete object)>. Registry state is deliberately excluded: each action, receipt, evidence record, and D acceptance keeps its own registry_snapshot_id plus physical producer revision. A replacement therefore invalidates only actions and incomplete attempts bound to the superseded pointer; evidence already accepted by D remains verifiable against its historical snapshot and producer. None of the referenced manifests may contain execution_contract_id, directly or transitively.
